raw_segments.text: Again, as many terms are used in the way of similitude, so people have come to talk of
the self-control of the man of perfected self-mastery in the way of similitude.
For the man of self-control and the man of perfected self-mastery have this in common,
that they do nothing against right reason on the impulse of bodily pleasures.
But then the former has bad desires, the latter not.
And the latter is so constituted, as not even to feel pleasure contrary to his reason, the
former feels but does not yield to it.
